title: Gaia indexer evaluates shell substitutions in directory arguments
summary: The -g directory is inserted into a double-quoted ls command passed to popen. Double quotes preserve command substitution. An exact-command synthetic marker printed before listing failed; this is distinct from metadata-extractor FND-000040. A directory copied from an untrusted source can execute with the invoking user privileges. Enumerate directories without a shell and check enumeration errors.
